subject.title: fix(infra): use || for empty socket path/token fallback in mergeExecApprovalsSocketDefaults

question: Is an explicitly empty exec-approvals socket token an invalid value that must fall back to a generated/current token, or a supported way to opt out of token authentication?
rationale: The PR intentionally changes persisted configuration behavior at a security-sensitive local socket boundary, but the supplied evidence proves the new mechanics rather than the existing compatibility contract.

options.title: Treat blank values as invalid
options.body: Confirm the contract, add regression coverage for blank normalized and current values, and merge the fallback correction.

options.title: Preserve explicit blank tokens
options.body: Keep the existing token semantics and narrow the change to the socket-path behavior if empty tokens are a supported opt-out.

recommendation.title: Treat blank values as invalid
recommendation.body: Confirm the contract, add regression coverage for blank normalized and current values, and merge the fallback correction.
